recentItems.title: New poll suggests Alberta separatism support is slipping
recentItems.description:
With a little more than three weeks to go until the Oct. 19 referendum, a new poll done for CBC News suggests support for separation has softened since spring.

Twenty-three per cent of respondents said they’d vote to start the legal process to hold a binding referendum, while 72 per cent said they’d vote to remain in Canada. Four per cent said they were unsure.

recentItems.title: U.S., China agree to tariff cuts and AI talks following Trump-Xi summit

recentItems.title: Is chocolate way more expensive than it used to be?
recentItems.description:
The weather is causing chocolate to get pricey. Extreme rain can kill cacao flowers and pods before they get a chance to develop. New research says rain is responsible for recent downswings in production, with climate change increasing the chance of similar such events in the future.
